samples.question: The dashed line is a vertical fold. Fold the left half onto the right like closing a book, so the column beside the fold stays beside it and the left columns reverse. Charcoal tiles are the stencil; pale tiles are empty. On the right, amber, cyan, and violet each fill six tiles. Which color has all six of its tiles covered by charcoal after folding? Answer amber, cyan, or violet.
